Physical_Environment.Location: Henan University, School of Psychology, Kaifeng, China

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (group: matching-first / nonmatching-first, between) x 9 (phase: baseline, training 1-7, post-test, within) x matching (matching / nonmatching, within) x identity (self / other, within), plus filler trials (no identity)

Block_Structure.Block_number: formal: 2 blocks; practice: 2 blocks (320-trial version) or 4 blocks (240-trial version)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 320-version: formal 2 x 160 = 320 trials, practice 2 x 24 = 48 trials; 240-version: formal 2 x 120 = 240 trials, practice 4 x 30 = 120 trials

Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (practice only; formal has no feedback)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Square, Circle; shape-label correspondence counterbalanced across participants by ID parity (even: self-circle/other-square; odd: self-square/other-circle)
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Self, Other (自我, 他人); Filler: 白栽, 地入 (pseudo-words referencing self/other in character structure)

exp2.detail: Experiment 2 of a dual-process evidence-accumulation model of the self-prioritization effect, adapted from Sui et al. (2012). 26 participants: matching-first group 14 (11001-11011, 21001-21003), nonmatching-first group 12 (12001-12010, 22001-22002); group determined by the 2nd ID digit. Software is PsychoPy (not E-Prime). Two program versions exist: 17 sessions used the 240-trial legacy version (11 in baseline + 6 in training2/4/5), the rest the 320-trial version; stimuli, timing, keys, and shape-label mapping are identical across versions. Group and TrialType columns added during merge; Matching column has 3 values: Matching (= match), Nonmatching (= mismatch), and filler (a meaningful no-identity trial type, kept as-is rather than coded NA; the raw PsychoPy code 'fill' was renamed to 'filler' in Clean). 26 participants x 9 sessions (baseline + training1-7 + formal) = 234 theoretical sessions; 18 sessions missing across 15 participants. Fully missing (both main and practice files absent; 13): 11001-training4, 11005-training4, 11007-training4, 11009-training5, 11011-training4, 11011-training7, 12001-baseline, 12003-training4, 12004-training4, 12008-training6, 12009-training3, 21003-training2, 21003-training4. Partially missing (practice file present but main file absent; 5): 11002-training2, 12002-training7, 12007-training3, 12007-training6, 22001-training4. training4 is the most commonly missing session (8 = 7 fully + 1 partially). Known data issues: baseline/11001 contains files whose ID column is mislabeled 11003 (belongs to 11001); the raw CSV resolves this by using the folder name as ID; baseline/12001 is a copy of 12002 (12001 own baseline missing); training3/11006 block 2 keys reversed (accuracy 0.925 after swapping o/p); training1/22002 keys reversed (corrected by fit_error.m); training3 and training4 of 12010 are the same session. Demographic bug (per original author): the program stored the ID first digit in the 'Gender' column, so the raw table's Gender column (values 1/2) is actually the ID first digit, not real gender; this Gender column is kept only in the raw CSV and dropped from the Clean CSV (it is not real demographic data); subj_info Gender is therefore NA. No standardized *_raw.csv produced yet; raw per-session PsychoPy exports are in Exp2/Raw/. Consolidated into study Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData (Exp2) on 2026-10-04. Session column = phase (baseline; training1-7; formal, where formal = the post-test); Phase column = practice/main, per phase. Both taken from the merged raw file Hu_YQ_2026_ChinaSciData_Exp2_raw.csv (built from Exp2/Raw/sub-*/ per-session PsychoPy exports).
